description: Test suite for argv helper functions in a CLI application, verifying argument parsing, flag detection, command extraction, and related utilities.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for grouping related test cases.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value meets certain conditions in tests.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description.

methods.name: it.each
methods.description: Parameterized test case execution over different data sets.

methods.name: buildParseArgv
methods.description: Constructs a parsed argv array from raw input, considering fallback arguments and program name.

methods.name: getFlagValue
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specific flag from argv.

methods.name: getCommandPath
methods.description: Gets the command path tokens up to a certain index, stopping at terminator or flag.

methods.name: getCommandPathWithRootOptions
methods.description: Gets command path while skipping known root options.

methods.name: getCommandPositionalsWithRootOptions
methods.description: Extracts positional arguments for routed commands, skipping interleaved root options.

methods.name: getPrimaryCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the primary command token, skipping global flags.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Checks if a specific flag is present before a terminator token.

methods.name: isRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Detects if the command is a root help invocation.

methods.name: isRootVersionInvocation
methods.description: Detects if the command is a root version invocation.

methods.name: shouldMigrateState
methods.description: Decides if the command implies migrating state based on command tokens.

methods.name: shouldMigrateStateFromPath
methods.description: Decides if state migration is applicable based on command path tokens.
